name: YMCA Camp Greenknoll
description_short: A YMCA day camp in Brookfield for ages 3 to 15, grouped by grade, open 7:30 am to 6 pm. Campers swim twice a day in the outdoor pool, with a lesson in the morning, and do STEAM, archery, arts and crafts and team building; older campers choose their own activities.
swim_waterfront_notes: Two swims a day: instructional in the morning, recreational in the afternoon, with Red Cross lifeguards. Swim levels tested each Monday; non-swimmers wear camp life vests.

Tuition assistance form 'coming soon'. Phone is the branch line until June 1 (203-775-9363 after). Some text on the page still refers to fall 2025 and fall 2026 grades.
